note: NEWTECONS Vietnamese lines whose WAV a person already listened to and approved (VoiceStudio omnivoice clone takes, 48 kHz stereo 16-bit). The take IS the receipt WAV: no conversion, no pitch transform, no trim, no split, so receipt_wav.sha256 equals the approved native sha256. A take in another format is refused, never converted. Listen approval stays mandatory (domain voice.require_listen_approval).
